title: Zoom Meeting Planner Stickers- Zoom
author: Happy Printables Club
description:
These are super cute Zoom Meeting Planner Stickers perfect for your planner. These will help to keep a track of all your zoom meetings taking place while you stay at home and work.
• Stickers measure approx. 1.5 x 1 inches
• Sticker sheet measures 8.5 x 11 inches
WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE:
Upon purchase, you will get a ZIP folder which includes-
    1 PDF FILE- 8.5 x 11
    1 JPEG FILE- 8.5 X 11
    1 PNG FILE- 8.5 X 11
TOTAL STICKERS IN ONE SHEET- 32
PLEASE NOTE:
Depending on your computer monitor and resolution, colors may appear different from the actual download. Therefore there may be some variance between the way colors look on your screen compare to the actual print.
